_readme: THE NATURAL COATS — the only colours a horse in this game is allowed to be.
'Horse should be brown, black or white, something majestic.' (the owner,
2026-08-09, looking at nine armies riding nine horses dyed in nine house
colours). A blue horse is a bug, not heraldry: a mount's house identity
lives in its CAPARISON, and the animal under that cloth is an animal.
So this table is a CLOSED LIST, and it is the list a house pack's `coat`
field must name (docs/HOUSE-PACK.md). A pack may also declare its own
palette inline, but every colour in it is held to the same law the role
gate holds a rendered coat to: saturation <= 0.20, OR hue inside the
warm-brown band 5-58 degrees. Nothing else is a horse.
Each palette names the horse's own material set (tools/props/convert_horse.py):
Main is the hide, Main_Light the blaze/socks, Main_Dark the ears and
shading, Muzzle the nose, Hair the mane and tail, Hooves the feet. The
MANE is deliberately pushed off the hide's own value in every coat — a
real chestnut's mane is the same colour as its body, and rendered at
chess-piece scale that is a horse with no mane and no tail.
